relevance_note: French PCD screening cohort that lists each GAMT-deficient patient's homozygous GAMT variant in Table 2 (e.g. "| e2 | c.289C > T | p.Q97X | 1 | - | This study |"), so individual genotypes are identifiable.
method_note: Hand-built with a short script from my reading; all spans checked verbatim. Cohort of 6,353 screened; 7 GAMT-deficient patients from 6 families (6 index + 1 brother found by familial inquiry); SLC6A8-deficient patients are out of scope (no rows). Individuals: Table 2 has no patient-label column, so the GAMT-variant carriers are labelled 'Table 2 row k' (k = data row after the two-line header, i.e. c.289C>T = row 1 ... c.577C>T = row 5). Row 2 (c.299_311dup13, '2^a', footnote 'Two affected siblings') covers two people: I labelled one 'Table 2 row 2' and the other 'brother of Table 2 row 2', because the only GAMT sib pair must be the family of the '1 brother affected with GAMT deficiency' found after familial inquiry (7 patients / 6 families, only one family with two). The 7th patient (GAMT gene not studied; 'DNA analysis was rejected by the parents') is 'unnamed person 1' and has no variant row. Table 2 'Reference' column gives the first description of each MUTATION (e.g. 'Dhar et al., 2009 [27]'), not a source for the patient (column header: 'Number of patients identified in this study'), so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported' for all. Zygosity homozygous taken from each person's Table 2 row (Homozygous column). Inheritance left 'not reported': text says 'presumed (parents not available for study) or confirmed (parents were heterozygous for the mutation)' without saying which patients; for c.391+15G>T only 'segregation of this mutation in his parents' is stated (recorded in parental_testing_statement). Variant type only where the abstract names the variant (nonsense c.289C>T, c.577C>T; splicing c.391+15G>T); the text's 'missense (n = 1) ... frame shift (n = 2)' is a list and was not assigned. is_proband left null for the six index patients ('index patients' is only a group term); false for the brother. Clinical features: only features given for ALL GAMT patients ('intellectual disability (100%) and speech delay (100%)', 'attention deficit (100%)', urine GAA:creatinine 'increased for all patients') were assigned to each of the 7 as 'inferred from group statement'; features with <100% frequency (epilepsy 57%, hypotonia 43%, aggressive behaviour 86%, autistic behaviour 43%, etc.) and Table 1 '+/++/+++' grades were not assigned to anyone. Table 1 '-' (defined as absence in all patients) appears in the GAMT column only under 'Signs leading to consult' (Autistic behavior), which is not a feature statement, so nothing was excluded. Speech delay was not mapped to the checklist item 'absent or limited speech'. Contradictions/inconsistencies: Methods and Results say GAMT activity was measured in lymphoblasts, while the Discussion says c.391+15G>T was 'linked with decreased GAMT activity in cultured fibroblasts'; Discussion says 'Five mutations were identified for GAMT gene in 6 unrelated families' but Table 2 shows 5 variants in 5 families (6 patients); the text says 'frame shift (n = 2)' whereas Table 1 lists the corresponding class as 'Duplication 2/6'. n_patients_reported = 6 (patients with a GAMT variant); 7 were diagnosed.
